explanation: DivideByZeroException is caught and handled; outputs "Caught".
catch(Exception e) catches all exception types; e.Message contains the thrown message.
int.Parse("abc") throws FormatException, caught by the first matching handler.
Inner catch doesn't match InvalidOperationException, so outer catch handles it.
re-throw (bare throw) prints message then re-throws the exception to outer scope.
finally block always executes, even when try returns; prints "Finally" before returning 1.
Calling a method on null throws NullReferenceException, caught and handled.
Exception filter (when clause) catches only if condition is true; year 2025 > 2000, so caught.
Array access with invalid index throws IndexOutOfRangeException, caught and handled.
Exception filter checks message; "Bad state" contains "Bad", so catch clause executes.
